name: Help menu
description: SuiteHelpCommands, the suite's Help menu: it replaces the system's empty help item with the suite Help catalog's items (Report a Problem…, Beta Notes and, in the launcher, Welcome to AfterGlow, which opens the tour), each a MenuCommand over a SuiteHelpDocument and disabled with its reason until its run is built. ShellHelpProvider adapts SuiteModel's ProblemReport and BetaNotes to the kernel's HelpProviding with this Mac's version, build, macOS and model. SuiteHelpPresenter shows the report sheet and the Beta Notes window; ProblemReportActions runs the sheet's Save… (an NSSavePanel and a .txt of the sheet's text) and Email… (the system's compose-mail service with ProblemReportOutput's subject, unsent), and neither opens a socket. Built by report-problem RP-2, RP-3 and RP-3e.
